gold_policy: immutable GOLD v2 unchanged; fresh all eight methods; no old result reuse
initial_plan_policy: B3 B4 P0 H share frozen B3 initial plan; B4 H share one constrained review
p0_policy: lossless compilation only; native validator compares explicit original public request, never repairs or infers missing slots
execution_definition: completed observed no spatial execution=false; confirmed successful spatial SQL=true; failed SQL=false; incomplete/unknown/contradictory=null
denominator_policy: same GOLD-selected spatial cases for all methods irrespective of answer shape; separately report attempted-conditional ESR and missingness
spatial_correctness: independent object/relation/distance contract, not SQL success
limits: shape correctness does not establish reviewer semantic correctness
operational deployment separate from research results
v3 observed failures used for development; no independent holdout claim
User-confirmed GOLD approval is separate from independent answer meaning scoring
v6 raw review failures used for development; new whole benchmark required; no holdout tuning
initial_plan_generation: typed_tool_plan_v1; B3 only schema-constrained, B0-B2 unchanged
review_failure_policy: Retain raw initial model verdict; self-contradictory checks or invalid=false with non-answer contract changes are unusable/missing review predictions, never corrected detections; B4/H share one failed receipt and do not execute the rejected repair
